Mujeres Mondays

McAllen, TX · Road

Women / trans / femme

Mujeres Mondays is a road group ride in McAllen, TX. It rolls every Monday at 6:30 pm from Bicycle World McAllen (shop parking lot).

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Mujeres Mondays group ride

A women-only Monday evening ride from the McAllen shop, run with the Corazón Racing women's team. Details each week go up on Corazón Racing's Facebook. Helmet and a working bike required.
